title: photo/{head_id}/pick payload
description: UPSERT payload of photo/{head_id}/pick: the photo the user chose to show for the figure, named by its image id. Last writer wins: the pick with the greater version replaces the other on every device. "Use default" is a DELETE with an empty payload, never an empty or null id. A client shows the pick only while the figure's image list carries that id. Serialized, at most 206 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

derivative_id.description: The picked image, as ProductImage.derivative_id names it: the 64 lowercase hex characters of the SHA-256 of the derivative's bytes. Never an address: no scheme, host, path or extension.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
